admission.statement: The primary collection sources identify the original skew-symmetric finite-difference shallow-water operator for a North Atlantic ocean submodel. Its source application was natural-mode eigenanalysis; the benchmark manufactures a linear workload on the unchanged PLSK operator.
Original title identifies a fully implicit black-oil simulator on a spatial grid. Fully implicit describes time/nonlinear treatment, not an established spatial discretization.
Original titles identify three-dimensional steam-injection reservoir models with explicit grid dimensions. Spatial discretization is not specified.
